summary: Counts how many dword entries in the array at a1+24 equal the value a2. Iterates v3 times, where v3 is the count read from the standings node at dword_7D2DB0 via LinkedListDereference and FlagsGetter; the count is re-read from the node at the end of every iteration. Returns 0 when the node is absent or the count is not greater than 0.

operations.description: Dereference the standings node from dword_7D2DB0 via LinkedListDereference; when absent, skip the loop and return the count 0.
Dereference the node again and read the loop count v3 via FlagsGetter; proceed only when v3 is greater than 0.
Iterate over the dwords starting at a1+24, once per count step, re-reading the node via LinkedListDereference and FlagsGetter at the end of each iteration to refresh the loop bound.
Compare the dword at the current array position against a2 and increment the match counter v4 when they are equal.
Return the accumulated match count v4.

unresolved: Whether the dword array at a1+24 and the value a2 are season/standings related beyond the ABI name is not independently confirmed.
Why the node is dereferenced twice at entry (a null check and again for the loop count) and why the count is refreshed each iteration is a decompiler artifact not explained by this packet.
The owning class of a1 and the role of the 24-byte prefix skipped before the counted array are unknown.
